note: Both sets include the same trivial figure-label component claims, but B adds substantive facts A omits: the EMCCD operating temperature (153 K), the thruster-firing cadence (every few 100 s), and a fuller optical path through the two dichroics, OAP and field stops. A is cleaner (no mislabeled attributes) and does capture the final f/# of 1330, which B drops even though its own quote contains it. B's flaws are one mislabeled attribute (calling the 'every few 100 s' period a 'frequency') and one garbled figure-label claim about sub-systems that omits the Spectrum EMCCD. On balance B covers more of the important specifications despite those two defects.
